content: टङ्कः, -ङ्कम् [टङ्क्-घञ् अच् वा] .²1 A hatchet, an axe; a stone-cutterʼs chisel; टङ्कैर्मनःशिलगुहेव विदार्यमाणा <ls>Mk. 1. 20</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 80</ls>; <ls>Ki. 9. 22</ls>. .²2 A sword. .²3 The sheath of a sword. .²4 A peak shaped like the edge of a hatchet; the slope or declivity of a hill; शिलाः सटङ्कशिखराः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 10. 46</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">10. 67. 26</ls>; <ls>Rām. 7. 5. 24</ls>. हिमाद्रिटङ्कादिव भान्ति यस्यां गङ्गाम्बुपातप्रतिमा गृहेभ्यः <ls>Bk. 1. 8</ls>. .²5 Anger. .²6 Pride. .²7 The leg. .²8 A chasm, cleft. .²9 The wood-apple tree. .²10 Borax. .²11 A weight of silver equal to four Māṣas; <ls>Śukra. 4. 179</ls>. .²12 The fruit of the wood-apple ({%n.%}) .²13 A stamped coin. .²14 A spade, hoe. .²15 Beauty, grace; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²16 The ankle; टङ्कोऽस्त्री टङ्कणे गुल्फे काणान्तरखनित्रयोः . कोशे ऽश्मदारणेऽपि स्याज्जङ्घायां मासि कथ्यते .. <ls>Nm.</ls> .²17 (in music) A kind of measure. .{@-का@} The leg.
